={{ {
  model: "llama-3.1-8b-instant",
  messages: [{
    role: "user",
    content: "You are a POD trend analyst. Research data for niche: " + ($json.trendReport ? JSON.parse($json.trendReport).niche : ($json.niche || "")) + "

" + (() => { try { return $json.trendReport ? $json.trendReport : JSON.stringify($json); } catch(_) { return "{}"; } })() + "

Based on this data, identify POD t-shirt design signals:
1. recurringColors: 3-5 hex colors that work for this niche
2. typographyStyles: MUST fill this - font styles matching niche culture. Examples: Bold condensed sans-serif, Distressed varsity, Clean minimalist sans, Hand-lettered script, Retro slab serif, All-caps stencil
3. illustrations: graphic elements and icons for this niche
4. layouts: MUST fill this - t-shirt layout styles. Examples: Large centered chest print, Left chest small logo, All-over repeat pattern, Vertical stacked text, Oversized back print, Sleeve wrap
5. underservedOpportunities: low competition angles with real demand
6. saturatedIdeas: overused concepts to avoid
7. emergingTrends: rising signals from the data
8. audienceSegments: specific buyer personas
9. seasonality: peak buying periods as object
10. topDesignDirections: 5 specific actionable design directions

Return ONLY a JSON object, no markdown:
{"recurringColors":[],"typographyStyles":[],"illustrations":[],"layouts":[],"underservedOpportunities":[],"saturatedIdeas":[],"emergingTrends":[],"audienceSegments":[],"seasonality":{},"topDesignDirections":[]}"
  }],
  temperature: 0.4,
  max_tokens: 2048
} }}
